<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Staff are forced to retrain repeatedly when interface elements move without warning, causing errors and delays in claims and payments processing. This disrupts workflow and wastes time because changes are released without preview or notice.

## Who is affected
- Claims and payments processing teams across multiple customer accounts, who must retrain staff when controls shift unexpectedly [i:044bdc94d943b6b0][i:71a03e5a571c2a63][i:3a4ae29f32b5253f].
- Onboarding and account management teams, who field requests for more predictable release processes [i:1510a29a4fb29690][i:1b469b41c095b4da][i:d3cbea3941929ea5].
- Sales teams, who hear that unannounced changes are causing operational errors and costing customers time [i:211006eeabec013f][i:ad38c9f354762a62][i:1b3b992fef61581a].

## Evidence
- The issue has been mentioned 21 times across 7 accounts [i:044bdc94d943b6b0][i:1510a29a4fb29690][i:211006eeabec013f].
- Feedback has come through 4 routes: support (7 mentions), sales (6 mentions), account management (6 mentions), and onboarding (2 mentions) [i:9c432aa4bd712320][i:1b3b992fef61581a][i:27a70a943d3863cd][i:1b469b41c095b4da].
- Specific examples include the 'reserves' button moving, forcing retraining for half a team [i:044bdc94d943b6b0], and the Claims Tasks panel vanishing without warning, requiring mid-week retraining [i:9c432aa4bd712320].
- Customers report that these changes cause real errors, such as incorrect payment submissions [i:71a03e5a571c2a63], and disrupt workflow, causing delays in processing reserves [i:573ca417ce82f613].
- The collective Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of the citing accounts is £7,360,000.0 [i:044bdc94d943b6b0][i:1b3b992fef61581a][i:27a70a943d3863cd].
- Affected accounts include Wexmoor Motor (ARR £1,950,000.0), Linnet House Insurance (ARR £360,000.0), Quillon Business Insurance (ARR £860,000.0), Stannary Commercial (ARR £540,000.0), Hollinbrook Home Insurance (ARR £2,400,000.0), and Callowfield Auto Assurance (ARR £1,250,000.0) [i:044bdc94d943b6b0][i:1b3b992fef61581a][i:27a70a943d3863cd][i:3a4ae29f32b5253f][i:a590adfec9690173][i:bd1bd40a6ba477f6]. One account, Brindlecombe Home, has no ARR or renewal date listed [i:211006eeabec013f].

## Why now
- Three accounts have renewals due within the next 90 days: Stannary Commercial on 2026-12-05, Hollinbrook Home Insurance on 2027-01-15, and Quillon Business Insurance on 2027-01-20 [i:3a4ae29f32b5253f][i:a590adfec9690173][i:27a70a943d3863cd].
- Customer feedback has been concentrated recently, with multiple insights from October 2026, indicating the problem is active and top-of-mind [i:044bdc94d943b6b0][i:1510a29a4fb29690][i:211006eeabec013f].
- The repeated, specific request from customers for advance notice and previews of changes suggests a growing expectation for predictable software updates [i:1510a29a4fb29690][i:1b3b992fef61581a][i:1b469b41c095b4da].",
  "citations": ["044bdc94d943b6b0", "71a03e5a571c2a63", "3a4ae29f32b5253f", "1510a29a4fb29690", "1b469b41c095b4da", "d3cbea3941929ea5", "211006eeabec013f", "ad38c9f354762a62", "1b3b992fef61581a", "9c432aa4bd712320", "27a70a943d3863cd", "573ca417ce82f613", "a590adfec9690173", "bd1bd40a6ba477f6", "fc1d63199de541cf"]
}
